title: No more logs
body: My last logs are dated Dec 25th. Something in the code stopped working when you installed unfinished mode.

comments.body:
I found the screenshot of the version I had installed on the 25th in the waste basket...

![Screenshot_20231225_183747_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/78d08b26-227c-46f4-b1de-6cd94a946df0)
with new libs version it's not possible to keep logs in `/AAPS/logs` directory and they are back in default location `/Android/data/info.nightscout.androidaps/files`
